item.title: State of Texas: Texas teachers may lose jobs for posts on Kirk's death
item.description: Some Texas educators risk losing their ability to teach over comments they made on social media in the wake of the shooting death of Turning Point USA founder Charlie Kirk.

item.title: 8-year-old child dies in crash in northwest Houston, HCSO says
item.description: An 8-year-old was killed and two injured in a car crash near a construction zone in northwest Houston, Harris County authorities said.

item.title: Former Longhorns shine for Seattle Seahawks in Super Bowl 60 victory
item.description: The former Texas Longhorns defensive lineman pounced on a fumble by New England quarterback Drake Maye with 0:16 left, giving the ball back to Seattle to set up a touchdown drive in the fourth quarter. It was the first fumble recovery of his professional career.

item.title: Super Bowl 60: Seahawks take second Super Bowl title, beating Patriots 29-13
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks bested the New England Patriots on Sunday at Super Bowl LX in a lopsided game with a historic defensive performance.
